title: erythropsis pallens
intro: Erythropsis pallens, commonly known as the pale erythropsis or white erythropsis, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Erythropsis pallens include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
